items.title: TikTok LIVE and the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art Bring the Hero’s Journey to Life in Exclusive Livestream
items.text: TikTok LIVE and the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art invite audiences from around the world to tune in to a special three-part LIVE event, The Art of Heroes, on Monday, November 9, from 5:30-8:15pm PT.
